cards.title: DEAL SCOUT
cards.concept: street deal scout in a grey rain trench with the collar turned up, a folded paper dossier tucked against his chest and a cheap earpiece with one tiny cyan LED, glasses and a knowing bright smile.
cards.hook: VP of M&A at Voyager Acquisition Corp: before any deal closes, someone has to scout the target.

cards.title: WETWARE LAB TECH
cards.concept: night-shift lab tech in a scuffed grey lab coat over a hoodie, safety goggles pushed up on his forehead above his glasses, holding a small rack of sample vials at his chest.
cards.hook: Biology degree from Pitzer: every biotech career starts at the bench.

cards.title: STREET PROMOTER
cards.concept: grinning street promoter in a grey bomber jacket and beanie pushed back off his hairline, fanning a stack of glossy blank flyers at his chest with a wrist display strapped on.
cards.hook: Marketing is in his bio, and his upbeat energy sells the hype one flyer at a time.

cards.title: CALL DESK REP
cards.concept: call-desk rep in a cheap grey suit with a slightly loosened tie and a budget headset mic, holding a cracked tablet of talking points to his chest, polite bright smile.
cards.hook: Investor relations: fielding every investor's call with suit-and-tie polish.

cards.title: GPU PAWNBROKER
cards.concept: back-alley pawnbroker in a worn grey utility vest, holding a scuffed graphics card up at his chest to appraise it, a jeweller's loupe hanging on a cord at his neck.
cards.hook: Capital markets meets Compute Labs: he knows exactly what a GPU is worth as an asset.

cards.title: GROWTH HACKER
cards.concept: growth operator in a dark hoodie with green terminal-code trim, a cyberdeck held at his chest projecting a small glowing green funnel hologram that narrows into a single bright green dot, a green-lit cable coiled from the deck to his wrist.
cards.hook: Head of Growth: the title practically makes him a growth hacker, running every lead down the funnel.

cards.title: FLOOR TRADER
cards.concept: trading-pit operator in a green-piped trader's jacket over shirt and tie, one hand raised in a pit hand signal and a handheld deck at his chest trailing a strip of green-glowing ticker tape.
cards.hook: Public-market M&A and capital markets: the trading floor is his home turf.

cards.title: AD DRONE PILOT
cards.concept: ad-drone pilot in a green-trimmed techwear bomber, a small quadcopter drone hovering at his shoulder towing a blank green-glowing banner, a controller with cyan buttons held at his chest.
cards.hook: Marketing, taken airborne over the neon skyline.

cards.title: STREET MEDIC
cards.concept: street-clinic quartermaster medic in a grey-and-green tactical jacket with a green cross patch on the shoulder, an open supply case of green-glowing auto-injectors held at his chest, handing one out with a bright smile.
cards.hook: COO at Vesicor Therapeutics: the operator who keeps a therapeutics outfit supplied, working the street clinic by clinic.

cards.title: BLANK CHECK FIXER
cards.concept: slick fixer in a sleek armoured long coat with glowing teal seams over a shirt and tie, holding up between two fingers a glowing teal blank holo-cheque card with a faint cyan glow.
cards.hook: VP of M&A at Voyager Acquisition Corp: in public-market M&A, the acquisition corp is the blank-check company, and he is the fixer who fills it in.

cards.title: GENE SPLICER
cards.concept: elite gene splicer in a sleek white-and-teal armoured lab coat with glowing seams, raising at his chest a splicing gauntlet with a glowing cyan cell-culture chip slotted into its wrist port, faint cyan sequence code scrolling along its edge.
cards.hook: Biology degree plus biotech operations at Vesicor Therapeutics: he knows the code of life.

cards.title: CORPO SPOKESMAN
cards.concept: polished corpo spokesman in a sharp armoured suit and tie with glowing teal seams on the lapels, a floating teal holo-microphone orb beside his chin and a confident beaming smile.
cards.hook: Investor relations and marketing: the trusted face that speaks for the company to its investors.

cards.title: MERGER NETRUNNER
cards.concept: chrome-augmented netrunner with polished chrome shoulder plates over a dark suit and tie and a violet neural jack at his temple, two glowing violet holographic corporate towers fusing into one behind his shoulders with magenta sparks.
cards.hook: Public-market M&A: in the net he merges whole corporations with a thought.

cards.title: NEON MARKET MAKER
cards.concept: chrome-armoured market maker in an ornate high-collared violet-and-chrome coat, one chrome hand raised as a few tall hot-pink and violet holographic candlestick bars rise behind him from a floating neon exchange sigil.
cards.hook: Head of Capital Markets at a company that turns GPUs into on-chain assets: in the neon exchange he does not follow the market, he makes it.

cards.title: GROWTH SINGULARITY
cards.concept: ascended executive in gold-and-white chrome regalia cut like a ceremonial suit and tie, a halo of glowing golden GPU cores and cyan circuit rings orbiting high above his short hair, a radiant golden light arrow soaring up behind his shoulders, beaming his bright smile behind his glasses.
cards.hook: Head of Growth in the compute world: where GPUs become capital, his growth curve goes vertical.
